page.overview:
Who is Lucas Bartmoss?

Lucas Bartmoss was a male Human who worked for the Galactic Empire as a janitor in the Imperial Data Processing Facility on the planet Tazan.

Sometime after the destruction of the planet Alderaan in 0 BBY, a team of Rebel Alliance agents traveled to Tazan and they persuaded Bartmoss to let them inside the Data Processing Facility.
